summary: Group of actionable suggestions, each with a short label and a separate prompt, without automatic submission.
whenToUse: Filling a composer with contextual prompts.

props.name: items
props.description: Each item has a unique id, label, prompt and optional icon.

props.name: onAction
props.description: The consumer decides whether to fill a field or start an action.

inherits: HTML attributes of the group, aria-label, className, style and an HTMLDivElement ref.
accessibility: Real buttons with text names; icons are decorative.
Localized group name, overridable with aria-label.
responsive: Suggestions wrap; no forced horizontal scrolling.
customization: Items can include an original icon provided by the consumer.
commonMistakes: Submitting prompts automatically without making that behavior clear.
limits: No generation or ranking of suggestions.
